notes.title: The AI grows stronger!
notes.notes:
With reports of the AI growing stronger, along with it taking control of all our AI Defenses, we have ordered a new starship to be available. An upgrade to the Destroyer, which, can cloak. 

This update has the following

-A new mission
-A new ships (That can cloak)
-Voice lines

The next update will take a break from the story, and ships, and add more exploration events that the player can come across. 

Until then o7.

notes.title: GE Is now in game!
notes.notes: GE is the main source of income for this game. Once you complete a mission, you will gain GE. Use GE to unlock new warships!

notes.title: Exploration.
notes.notes:
I wanted this to be in the game to have this mode when It was added on steam, but yay for bugs!

Anyway, in this mode you can use the exploration scout ship to explore the galaxy! The radar station has a new button on the left side of the panel (This UI is WIP.) Once you click that, a new screen will pop up, were there is a green bar. This green bar once clicked, will show a new one will be show. There are 8 green bars in total, charging the warp drive. Once all 8 are enabled, you can jump to a new system!

There are over 20 different systems you can encounter, with more added every content update!
